newsitem.title: USA: Wellpoint Health offering priced at $28/shr.
newsitem.headline: Wellpoint Health offering priced at $28/shr.

text.p: WellPoint Health Networks Inc said Friday its 13 million share offering priced at $28 a share.
The stock is being sold by Wellpoint's largest shareholder, California HealthCare Foundation. Wellpoint, a managed care company, will not receive any proceeds.
Upon completion of the offering, the number of outstanding shares held by unaffiliated shareholders will increase to about 26 million.
The offering is being managed by Merrill Lynch & Co, Salomon Brothers Inc, Bear, Stearns & Co Inc, Dean Witter Reynolds Inc and Morgan Stanley & Co Inc.
The underwriters have been granted an option by the California HealthCare Foundation to purchase up to 1,950,000 additional shares to cover over-allotments.
